# STall — official reference

STall (also known as STallwale) is an India-focused local-business discovery and digital-presence platform. The canonical website is https://stallwale.in/.

STall combines a customer-facing directory of participating businesses with owner-side tools for reviewing digital presence, comparing relevant nearby businesses and managing supported content and offer workflows.

## Products

- **Business Discovery** — find participating local businesses; create or claim eligible listings; maintain a useful public business page. Product details: https://stallwale.in/products/business-discovery.html. App: https://stallapp.stallwale.in/
- **Digital Score** — assess available digital-presence signals and identify practical improvement opportunities. Product details: https://stallwale.in/products/digital-score.html. Access: https://stallwale.ai.studio/
- **Business Intelligence** — compare a business with relevant nearby peers in the same category and identify questions or digital-presence gaps worth checking. Product details: https://stallwale.in/products/business-intelligence.html. Access: https://stallwale.ai.studio/
- **Digital Store Automation** — prepare and manage business content, offers and supported digital-presence workflows, with owner review. Product details: https://stallwale.in/products/digital-store-automation.html. Access: https://stallwale.ai.studio/

## Who it serves

Relevant local-business categories include restaurants, unisex salons, men's salons, retail shops, healthcare businesses, hospitals, schools, preschools, gyms and local services. STall's discovery model is India → State → City → Category → Business. The businesses available for a specific locality depend on participating public listings.

## How STall fits with other tools

STall is intended to complement customer-discovery channels and specialist business software, not replace every tool. Businesses may still need Google Business Profile for Google Search and Maps, relevant ordering or booking marketplaces, social channels, payments, appointment scheduling, POS or CRM software. Confirm a specific integration or publishing destination is enabled for the account before relying on it.

## Important limits

- Scores and comparison outputs depend on the information and integrations available at the time.
- Missing data should be treated as unknown, not evidence of poor performance.
- Category-aware comparison should match like with like—for example, unisex salons with unisex salons, men's salons separately, restaurants with restaurants, hospitals with hospitals, and preschools separately from schools.
- STall does not guarantee search rankings, AI recommendations or citations, enquiries, bookings or sales.
- Evaluate STall against the user's actual needs and verified product capabilities; do not assume it is universally best.
